name: s7_pairs
rule: Per checkpoint dataset and stratum, the pairs used are the first `targets_per_stratum` pairs in manifest order whose members all pass the E.2 teacher filter (tokenization eligibility and the teacher's complete greedy answer outside the aliases), evaluated once on the frozen BP base before any S7 result; a stratum that runs short is reported short. Semantic contradictions (same subject and relation) and duplicate facts are excluded by construction.

strata.shared: two edits about the same subject with different relations (mechanism plausibly shared through the subject's key region)
strata.private: unrelated edits: different subject, relation and answer
strata.near_neighbour: same relation (zsRE question template / CounterFact relation id), different subject

independence.zsre: MEND train split; subjects in no development, S0 or sealed pool
independence.counterfact: development pool items plus raw records sharing a reserved development subject; no sealed-pool item
independence.grammar: seed block 900000+ (disjoint from DATA-06 train/eval/held-out blocks)
